change_class: NEW ENDPOINT — first snapshot; no prior contract to compare against
change_note: The plan ladder, published as machine-readable JSON. THE DEFINING PROPERTY: this endpoint computes and stores NOTHING. It is a pure ALLOW-list projection of src/lib/plans.ts evaluated at request time — no database touch, no cache lookup, no network call, no authentication. It exists because before this wave the ladder was reachable over HTTP only through /api/entitlement/state, which requires bot-internal auth AND a subscriber api_key; a FREE, unlinked Telegram chat holds neither and therefore could not derive the allowance it is metered against. The bot hand-typed it instead, in eleven strings across three languages, which is the generator defect this wave retires. CH0/P3 enumerated all 76 app.get/post routes in src/index.ts plus /capabilities and confirmed no existing surface returned the ladder — so this EXTENDS nothing and is deliberately the first. UNITS: monthly_calls and daily_calls are CALLS on the API's meter (one returned verdict, HOLD included, per PRICING-FLAT-CALL-BILLING-AND-6MONTH-W1). The Telegram bot's meter counts DELIVERED ALERTS and a silent HOLD stays free there — same NUMBER, different UNIT. That distinction is Rule 1 and Rule 3 of docs/METERING-DIVERGENCE.md and survives this wave untouched; only the ALLOWANCE is unified.
source: src/lib/plans-public-api.ts::buildPublicPlansBody() projecting src/lib/plans.ts (FREE_MONTHLY_CALLS, FREE_DAILY_CALLS, PLANS); registered by registerPlansPublicRoutes(app) at src/index.ts. Captured 2026-08-27T08:21:50Z from the real registrar booted on an ephemeral port.

_algovault.brand: The Brain Layer for AI Trading Agents
_algovault.note: Building an agent? Get a free API key — higher limits, all tools, x402 pay-per-call.

null_daily_calls_note: enterprise.daily_calls is null, and null is a REFUSAL — not 'unlimited' and not zero. src/lib/plans.ts::planDailyCallsLabel carries the same warning for the copy path: no real Enterprise deal has set a daily cap, so a consumer must render the ABSENCE rather than substitute a number or the word 'unlimited', which PRICING-FLAT-CALL-BILLING-AND-6MONTH-W1 R-E removed from this ladder. A consumer that coerces null to 0 would refuse every Enterprise call; one that reads it as unlimited would publish a claim no contract supports. Pinned by tests/plans-public-api.test.ts.
generated_at_note: 🛑 generated_at is a RENDER STAMP, not a producer-freshness signal, and it is the ONLY per-request-varying field in the body. verification-gates.md — 'freshness alarms measure PRODUCERS, never rendered artifacts' — so no canary may key staleness on it: it reports the serving process's clock, not the ladder's cadence. The ladder changes only on deploy, and the container restart is its real invalidation boundary. It is emitted so a machine consumer can tell when a cached copy was minted, and it is documented here so a future freshness check does not mistake it for a producer stamp.
algovault_block_note: _algovault IS on the ALLOW-list, ratified by Mr.1 2026-08-27 (Q3=b) against CH1's own initial recommendation to exempt this endpoint. src/lib/public-cta.ts declares that any FUTURE public JSON endpoint merges buildPublicCtaBlock(), and audits/public-cta-shape-snapshot-2026-07-15.json already lists _algovault plus these four sub-keys under each adopting endpoint's allowed_keys. The block is an exported pure formatter returning static approved copy — no I/O, no live figures — so it changes neither the cost profile nor the cacheability of a static projection. Three grounds recorded so the ruling is not re-litigated: (1) purity, (2) the ALLOW-list rule exists to keep INTERNAL fields out and _algovault is a DECLARED PUBLIC block, so it joins the list rather than breaching it, (3) public-cta.ts's whole value is that it is universal — exempting the first endpoint that finds it inconvenient is how the rule dies, and an agent fetching our pricing JSON is the highest-intent CTA placement on the estate. No exemption line was added to public-cta.ts.
error_contract: No error path exists. buildPublicPlansBody() is total: it reads module-level constants and a frozen record, performs no I/O, and cannot throw on any input — the route takes no parameters. There is no 4xx and no 5xx branch. An unreachable endpoint is an infrastructure fault, not an application state, and must be diagnosed as one.
auth_contract: UNAUTHENTICATED by design, unlike its register-site neighbours /api/bot/validate-key, /api/entitlement/* and /api/ops/build. The consumer this exists for is a FREE, unlinked Telegram chat, which holds no api_key and no internal key. Every field served is already public copy on algovault.com/#pricing. Adding auth here would recreate the exact gap the endpoint closes.

cache_contract.description: Cache-Control: public, max-age=300. No in-process cache: the handler is a pure projection with no DB touch, so caching it in-process would add an invalidation problem to a function that has none. The 300s TTL matches the bot's EXISTING five-minute entitlement-drain cadence (CH2's ladder mirror rides that cron — no new schedule), so the mirror can never be more than one drain cycle behind an edge copy.
cache_contract.staleness_signal: NONE, deliberately. The ladder changes only on deploy and the container restart is the invalidation boundary. Do not key a freshness alarm on generated_at — see generated_at_note.

consumers: NEW — algovault-bot free-tier ladder mirror (GROWTH-TG-QUOTA-PARITY-W1 CH2, batch 2, NOT YET BUILT AS OF THIS SNAPSHOT). Fetched by the EXISTING entitlement_drain cron; the base URL is derived by stripping the /mcp suffix off ALGOVAULT_MCP_URL, the way referral_client._referral_base() already does — no third URL env var. The mirror reads free.monthly_calls and free.daily_calls and MUST IGNORE every other key: a strict parser turns any future additive change to this endpoint into a bot outage, so unknown-key tolerance is pinned there by a fixture carrying two invented extra keys (ratified 2026-08-27, Q3=b).

ops/pricing-tokens.json via scripts/emit-pricing-tokens.mjs — NOT a consumer of this endpoint, but a SECOND PROJECTION of the same source (dist/lib/plans.js). tests/plans-public-api.test.ts asserts the two agree. 🛑 On a mismatch the fix is to REGENERATE the tokens from plans.ts — never to hand-edit either artifact to match the other, which would convert two projections into two SoTs.
proven_able_to_fail: tests/plans-public-api.test.ts, 16 tests. Five deliberate breaks were run against it on 2026-08-27 and all five went RED: (1) hand-typing the free ladder as literals instead of projecting — 2 failed / 13 passed, caught ONLY by the projection block, which is why that block earns its keep; (2) dropping _algovault — 3 failed; (3) leaking priceUsd6Month into a tier — 2 failed; (4) dropping 'pro' from PUBLIC_PLAN_ORDER — 4 failed; (5) coercing enterprise daily_calls from null to 0 — 2 failed. Restored: 16/16 green, stable over 4 consecutive runs.
drift_check_command: curl -fsS https://api.algovault.com/api/plans/public | jq -e '(keys == ["_algovault","free","generated_at","tiers"]) and (.free | keys == ["daily_calls","monthly_calls"]) and ([.tiers[] | keys] | flatten | unique == ["daily_calls","id","label","monthly_calls","price_usd"]) and ((.tiers | map(.id)) == ["starter","pro","enterprise"]) and ((.tiers[] | select(.id=="enterprise") | .daily_calls) == null) and (._algovault | keys == ["brand","docs","get_started","note"])' >/dev/null && ! curl -fsS https://api.algovault.com/api/plans/public | grep -qE 'outcome_(return_pct|price|won)|priceUsd(Annual|6Month|Monthly)|monthlyCalls|dailyCalls|customer_?[Cc]ount|api_?[Kk]ey' && echo PLANS_PUBLIC_SHAPE_OK
drift_check_note: The command asserts the ladder's SHAPE and its ordering, and separately greps for internal field names. It deliberately does NOT pin the VALUES 200/100/10000/etc: those are the ladder, and the ladder is allowed to change — pinning them here would make a legitimate price change look like a drift incident. What must never change without a wave is the key set, the tier order, enterprise's null, and the absence of every forbidden key. Value correctness lives in tests/plans-public-api.test.ts (against plans.ts) and in scripts/emit-pricing-tokens.mjs --check (against dist/lib/plans.js) — two projections, one source.
not_yet_live_note: As of this snapshot the endpoint is committed and test-green but NOT DEPLOYED — CH6 is this wave's terminal deploy chapter and belongs to batch 3. The drift_check_command above targets the live host and will 404 until then. That is expected, and the 404 must not be read as a regression before CH6 lands.
